controls.label: Cylinder radius
controls.liveBehaviour: Apply live through the Scene-native adapter; commit one undo transaction on change end.
controls.keyboardInteraction: Arrow keys adjust one step; Shift+Arrow ten steps where numeric; Space toggles boolean.
controls.touchInteraction: Direct manipulation with at least 44 CSS px target.
controls.conditionalApplicability: Always unless the active fixture or Scene-native prototype explicitly reports unsupported.
controls.disabledStateReason: Disabled when the adapter cannot safely bind the original control or the active fixture makes it inapplicable.
controls.evaluatorOutputAffected: At fixed media, canvas, and story time, every non-gate card changes x position while source order, phase, and card size remain unchanged.
